release: Kosif v36.1 — Deep Audit & Verified AI

basis.archiveUsePolicy: Used as a capability-recovery reference only. Current corrected standards data takes precedence over older OCR/classification metadata.

aiGate.keyStorage: AI provider keys remain client-side/in-memory; server session stores only SHA-256 fingerprints of provider+model+key after a successful real connection test
aiGate.lockedInput: API key fields are readonly, emptied, paste/beforeinput blocked until owner session is unlocked
aiGate.statusPolicy: A key being present never means connected. Green/connected status is allowed only after a successful /api/kosif/ai/test for the same provider, model and key in the current owner session.
aiGate.councilPolicy: Review Council requires at least two independently tested providers; Claude chairs only when its own key/model has passed testing.

standardsReader.dataPolicy: Reader capabilities restored without reverting to the old archive's known OCR/classification issues.
standardsReader.metadataFix: 2025 library metadata corrected from 33 to 34 because b3/34.json is a real chapter: معيار محاسبة الزكاة (المعدل).
